differences: The deposit's derived tables (intertrialvariability.csv, tbt_between.csv, tbt_within.csv: inter-trial variability decay and success-dependent trial-to-trial change statistics) are not carried over; they are computed from shot-level data that the authors did not share.
The paper's EEG band is given as 12-30 Hz in one place and 13-30 Hz in another; pmbr_percent is the authors' value as shared.
Per-participant age and sex are not in the deposit (the paper reports 20 men and 12 women, aged 20 to 25).
